requirements.quote: The Server is permitted to start sending PUBLISH packets matching the Subscription before the Server sends the SUBACK Packet.
requirements.condition: After a Server has received a SUBSCRIBE and before it sends the corresponding SUBACK.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit matching PUBLISH packets to be sent to the subscribing Client during this interval.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Require SUBACK receipt as a prerequisite for accepting a matching PUBLISH from the Server.
requirements.why_checkable: A Server can send a matching PUBLISH before SUBACK and Client handling of the allowed ordering can be observed.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet containing a Topic Filter that is identical to an existing Subscription’s Topic Filter then it MUST completely replace that existing Subscription with a new Subscription.
requirements.condition: When a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE containing a Topic Filter identical to an existing Subscription's Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Completely replace the existing Subscription with a new Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscription state before and after re-subscribing to an identical filter can be compared.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filter in the new Subscription will be identical to that in the previous Subscription, although its maximum QoS value could be different.
requirements.condition: When replacing an existing Subscription because a newly received Topic Filter is identical.
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve the identical Topic Filter in the replacement Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: The replacement Subscription's filter can be compared character-for-character with the prior filter.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filter in the new Subscription will be identical to that in the previous Subscription, although its maximum QoS value could be different.
requirements.condition: When replacing an existing Subscription for an identical Topic Filter with a newly requested or granted maximum QoS.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the replacement Subscription's maximum QoS to differ from the previous Subscription's maximum QoS.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Force the replacement Subscription to retain the previous maximum QoS solely because the Topic Filter is unchanged.
requirements.why_checkable: The same filter can be subscribed again with a different QoS and the resulting delivery ceiling observed.

requirements.quote: Any existing retained messages matching the Topic Filter MUST be re-sent, but the flow of publications MUST NOT be interrupted [MQTT-3.8.4-3].
requirements.condition: When an existing Subscription is replaced by a new Subscription with an identical Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Re-send every existing retained message that matches the Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: Matching retained messages can be installed before re-subscription and the re-sent set compared with them.

requirements.quote: Any existing retained messages matching the Topic Filter MUST be re-sent, but the flow of publications MUST NOT be interrupted [MQTT-3.8.4-3].
requirements.condition: While replacing an existing Subscription with a new Subscription for an identical Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Continue the flow of publications without interruption.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Interrupt publication flow during the replacement.
requirements.why_checkable: Publications can be sent during re-subscription and continuity of delivery can be observed.

requirements.quote: Where the Topic Filter is not identical to any existing Subscription’s filter, a new Subscription is created and all matching retained messages are sent.
requirements.condition: When a received Topic Filter is not identical to any existing Subscription's filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Create a new Subscription for that Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: Server Subscription state can be inspected or inferred from subsequent matching deliveries.

requirements.quote: Where the Topic Filter is not identical to any existing Subscription’s filter, a new Subscription is created and all matching retained messages are sent.
requirements.condition: When a new Subscription is created for a Topic Filter not identical to any existing Subscription filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Send all retained messages matching the new Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: A known retained-message set can be installed before subscribing and compared with the messages delivered afterward.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE packet that contains multiple Topic Filters it MUST handle that packet as if it had received a sequence of multiple SUBSCRIBE packets, except that it combines their responses into a single SUBACK response [MQTT-3.8.4-4].
requirements.condition: When a Server receives one SUBSCRIBE packet containing multiple Topic Filters.
requirements.required_behavior: Handle its Topic Filters as a sequence of individual SUBSCRIBE packets.
requirements.why_checkable: The resulting Subscription state and retained deliveries can be compared with processing equivalent individual SUBSCRIBE packets.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE packet that contains multiple Topic Filters it MUST handle that packet as if it had received a sequence of multiple SUBSCRIBE packets, except that it combines their responses into a single SUBACK response [MQTT-3.8.4-4].
requirements.condition: When responding to one SUBSCRIBE packet containing multiple Topic Filters.
requirements.required_behavior: Combine the responses for all Topic Filters into one SUBACK response.
requirements.why_checkable: The number and contents of SUBACK packets emitted for a multi-filter SUBSCRIBE can be observed.

requirements.quote: The SUBACK Packet sent by the Server to the Client MUST contain a return code for each Topic Filter/QoS pair.
requirements.condition: When a Server sends a SUBACK for a SUBSCRIBE containing one or more Topic Filter/QoS pairs.
requirements.required_behavior: Include exactly one return code for each Topic Filter/QoS pair.
requirements.why_checkable: The number of SUBACK return codes can be compared with the number of requested pairs.

requirements.quote: This return code MUST either show the maximum QoS that was granted for that Subscription or indicate that the subscription failed [MQTT-3.8.4-5].
requirements.condition: For each return code in a SUBACK Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent either the maximum QoS granted for the corresponding Subscription or a subscription failure.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use the return code to represent any other outcome.
requirements.why_checkable: Each encoded return code can be decoded and matched to its allowed success or failure meaning.

requirements.quote: The Server might grant a lower maximum QoS than the subscriber requested.
requirements.condition: When a subscriber requests a maximum QoS for a Subscription.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the Server to grant a lower maximum QoS than requested and handle the lower grant.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Require the granted maximum QoS always to equal the requested maximum QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: A Server can return a lower successful grant and subsequent Client and delivery behavior can be observed.

requirements.quote: The QoS of Payload Messages sent in response to a Subscription MUST be the minimum of the QoS of the originally published message and the maximum QoS granted by the Server.
requirements.condition: When a Server sends a Payload Message in response to a Subscription.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the outgoing QoS to the smaller of the original publication QoS and the maximum QoS granted for the Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: All combinations of original and granted QoS can be exercised and the outgoing QoS compared with their minimum.

requirements.quote: The server is permitted to send duplicate copies of a message to a subscriber in the case where the original message was published with QoS 1 and the maximum QoS granted was QoS 0 [MQTT-3.8.4-6].
requirements.condition: When the original message was published at QoS 1 and the Subscription's granted maximum QoS is 0.
requirements.required_behavior: Tolerate duplicate copies delivered by the Server despite the outgoing QoS 0 downgrade.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat duplicate delivery in this specific downgrade case as necessarily nonconformant.
requirements.why_checkable: The downgrade scenario can be induced with a retransmitted QoS 1 publication and duplicate subscriber deliveries observed.

requirements.quote: If the subscribing Client has been granted maximum QoS 0, then an Application Message originally published as QoS 2 might get lost on the hop to the Client, but the Server should never send a duplicate of that Message.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message originally published at QoS 2 is delivered under a Subscription whose maximum QoS is 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Send a duplicate copy of that Application Message to the subscribing Client.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated delivery can be monitored in the specified QoS 2-to-QoS 0 downgrade scenario.

requirements.quote: A SUBACK Packet is sent by the Server to the Client to confirm receipt and processing of a SUBSCRIBE Packet.
requirements.condition: After a Server receives and processes a SUBSCRIBE Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Send a SUBACK Packet to the Client as confirmation.
requirements.why_checkable: A SUBSCRIBE can be sent and the Server response observed after processing.

requirements.quote:
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (9)	Reserved
	1	0	0	1	0	0	0	0
requirements.condition: When encoding the SUBACK fixed header byte 1.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bits 7 through 4 to 1,0,0,1, representing MQTT Control Packet type 9.
requirements.why_checkable: The high nibble of SUBACK byte 1 can be compared with binary 1001.

requirements.quote:
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (9)	Reserved
	1	0	0	1	0	0	0	0
requirements.condition: When encoding the SUBACK fixed header byte 1.
requirements.required_behavior: Set reserved bits 3 through 0 to 0,0,0,0.
requirements.why_checkable: The low nibble of SUBACK byte 1 can be compared with binary 0000.

requirements.quote: byte 2	Remaining Length
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Begin the Remaining Length field at byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The second byte and any continuation bytes can be parsed as Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: This is the length of variable header (2 bytes) plus the length of the payload.
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Packet variable header.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a variable-header length of exactly two bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The SUBACK variable header width can be measured directly.

requirements.quote: This is the length of variable header (2 bytes) plus the length of the payload.
requirements.condition: When calculating a SUBACK Packet's Remaining Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Set Remaining Length to 2 plus the payload length in bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The declared value can be compared with two variable-header bytes plus the measured payload bytes.

requirements.quote: The variable header contains the Packet Identifier from the SUBSCRIBE Packet that is being acknowledged.
requirements.condition: When encoding the variable header of a SUBACK Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Copy the Packet Identifier from the SUBSCRIBE Packet being acknowledged.
requirements.why_checkable: The SUBSCRIBE and corresponding SUBACK identifiers can be compared.

requirements.quote: byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Packet Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Packet Identifier's most significant byte in variable-header byte 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The first variable-header byte can be compared with the identifier's high eight bits.

requirements.quote: byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Packet Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Packet Identifier's least significant byte in variable-header byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The second variable-header byte can be compared with the identifier's low eight bits.

requirements.quote: The payload contains a list of return codes.
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Packet payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the payload as a list of return codes.
requirements.why_checkable: The payload can be parsed as consecutive return-code entries.

requirements.quote: Each return code corresponds to a Topic Filter in the SUBSCRIBE Packet being acknowledged.
requirements.condition: For each return code in a SUBACK Packet payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Associate it with one Topic Filter in the acknowledged SUBSCRIBE Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The return-code count and positions can be correlated with the acknowledged filter list.

requirements.quote: The order of return codes in the SUBACK Packet MUST match the order of Topic Filters in the SUBSCRIBE Packet [MQTT-3.9.3-1].
requirements.condition: When a SUBACK acknowledges a SUBSCRIBE containing multiple Topic Filters.
requirements.required_behavior: Order the SUBACK return codes in the same order as the SUBSCRIBE Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: Distinct per-filter outcomes make positional correspondence directly testable.

requirements.quote: Figure 3.26 - Payload format below illustrates the Return Code field encoded in a byte in the Payload.
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK return code in the payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode each Return Code field in exactly one byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The payload length can be compared with the number of return-code entries.

requirements.quote: byte 1	X	0	0	0	0	0	X	X
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK Return Code byte.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bits 6 through 2 to zero.
requirements.why_checkable: A mask over bits 6 through 2 can verify that all five bits are zero.

requirements.quote: 0x00 - Success - Maximum QoS 0
requirements.condition: When a Subscription succeeds with granted maximum QoS 0.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode SUBACK return code 0x00.
requirements.why_checkable: The outcome and exact payload byte can be compared.

requirements.quote: 0x01 - Success - Maximum QoS 1
requirements.condition: When a Subscription succeeds with granted maximum QoS 1.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode SUBACK return code 0x01.
requirements.why_checkable: The outcome and exact payload byte can be compared.

requirements.quote: 0x02 - Success - Maximum QoS 2
requirements.condition: When a Subscription succeeds with granted maximum QoS 2.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode SUBACK return code 0x02.
requirements.why_checkable: The outcome and exact payload byte can be compared.

requirements.quote: 0x80 - Failure
requirements.condition: When a Subscription fails.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode SUBACK return code 0x80.
requirements.why_checkable: The failure outcome and exact payload byte can be compared.

requirements.quote: SUBACK return codes other than 0x00, 0x01, 0x02 and 0x80 are reserved and MUST NOT be used [MQTT-3.9.3-2].
requirements.condition: When encoding a SUBACK return code.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use any value other than 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, or 0x80.
requirements.why_checkable: Every emitted return-code byte can be checked against the four-value allowlist.

requirements.quote:
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (10)	Reserved
	1	0	1	0	0	0	1	0
requirements.condition: When encoding UNSUBSCRIBE fixed header byte 1.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bits 7 through 4 to 1,0,1,0, representing MQTT Control Packet type 10.
requirements.why_checkable: The high nibble of UNSUBSCRIBE byte 1 can be compared with binary 1010.

requirements.quote: byte 2	Remaining Length
requirements.condition: When encoding an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Begin the Remaining Length field at byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The second byte and any continuation bytes can be parsed as Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: When encoding bit 3 of an UNSUBSCRIBE fixed header.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bit 3 to 0.
requirements.why_checkable: The bit can be extracted from fixed header byte 1 and compared with zero.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: When encoding bit 2 of an UNSUBSCRIBE fixed header.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bit 2 to 0.
requirements.why_checkable: The bit can be extracted from fixed header byte 1 and compared with zero.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: When encoding bit 1 of an UNSUBSCRIBE fixed header.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bit 1 to 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The bit can be extracted from fixed header byte 1 and compared with one.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: When encoding bit 0 of an UNSUBSCRIBE fixed header.
requirements.required_behavior: Set bit 0 to 0.
requirements.why_checkable: The bit can be extracted from fixed header byte 1 and compared with zero.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.10.1-1].
requirements.condition: When a Server receives an UNSUBSCRIBE whose reserved fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0,0,1,0.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the UNSUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Each invalid low-nibble value can be injected and the malformed-packet path observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.10.1-1].
requirements.condition: When a Server receives an UNSUBSCRIBE whose reserved fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0,0,1,0.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which the malformed packet was received.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the Network Connection instead of continuing to process traffic on it.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid low nibble can be injected and connection closure observed independently of error classification.

requirements.quote: This is the length of variable header (2 bytes) plus the length of the payload.
requirements.condition: When encoding an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet variable header.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a variable-header length of exactly two bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The UNSUBSCRIBE variable header width can be measured directly.

requirements.quote: This is the length of variable header (2 bytes) plus the length of the payload.
requirements.condition: When calculating an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet's Remaining Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Set Remaining Length to 2 plus the payload length in bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The declared value can be compared with two variable-header bytes plus the measured payload bytes.

requirements.quote: The variable header contains a Packet Identifier.
requirements.condition: When encoding an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet variable header.
requirements.required_behavior: Include a Packet Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The variable header can be parsed to verify identifier presence.

requirements.quote: byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
requirements.condition: When encoding an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Packet Identifier's most significant byte in variable-header byte 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The first variable-header byte can be compared with the identifier's high eight bits.

requirements.quote: byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: When encoding an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Packet Identifier's least significant byte in variable-header byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The second variable-header byte can be compared with the identifier's low eight bits.
